name: NEVERDREAM
source:
It is the year 2798.

Somebody has left a box on your doorstep.
What's inside will change you.
Or were you already changing from the beginning?

NEVERDREAM is a short visual novel about an android being 'gifted' emotions and losing herself in a video game while trying to figure out what that entails.

[From [url=https://red-mccloud.itch.io/neverdream]itch.io[/url]]
